description: This PHP source file defines the class Zend_Loader_PluginLoader, which implements the Zend_Loader_PluginLoader_Interface. It provides methods for managing plugin class loading, path registration, class resolution, and caching mechanisms within the Zend Framework's loader component.

classes.name: Zend_Loader_PluginLoader
classes.description: A class loader responsible for dynamically loading plugin classes based on prefix-to-path mappings, with support for static registry, caching, and dynamic class resolution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the plugin loader with optional prefix-to-path mappings and static registry name.

methods.name: _formatPrefix
methods.description: Formats a given prefix to ensure it ends with an underscore or has a consistent format.

methods.name: addPrefixPath
methods.description: Adds a new prefix-to-path mapping to the loader's registry.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Retrieves the list of paths associated with a prefix, or all if no prefix is specified.

methods.name: clearPaths
methods.description: Clears the path mappings for a specific prefix or all prefixes.

methods.name: removePrefixPath
methods.description: Removes a specific prefix and optional path from the registry.

methods.name: _formatName
methods.description: Normalizes plugin class names by ensuring proper casing.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a plugin with the given name is already loaded.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the full class name for a plugin by name if loaded.

methods.name: getClassPath
methods.description: Returns the file path of a loaded plugin class.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a plugin class by name, searching registered paths, and includes its file.

methods.name: setIncludeFileCache
methods.description: Sets the path for a cache file that stores include_once statements for plugin classes.

methods.name: getIncludeFileCache
methods.description: Retrieves the current cache file path for plugin classes.

methods.name: _appendIncFile
methods.description: Appends a file include statement to the class cache file.
